notes: A character's own memories list has a search bar now — four hundred memories was more than a list you could only scroll. It filters as you type, the heading counts what matched against the total, and a cross clears it. While you are searching, the Write a memory and Memory scan rows step out of the way, since looking for something already written down is not the moment to be offered two ways of adding more; they come back when the search clears. Editing, pinning and deleting all work on the filtered list and keep your search afterwards, and moving to a different character clears it so their list is not silently hiding most of itself. Both searches — this one and the one on the Memories tab — now match on words rather than on the exact phrase, so 'volvo green' finds the green Volvo, partial words like 'driv' find driving and drive, and an apostrophe typed mid-word no longer breaks the word it is in.
